summary_md: **Enes Kantepe ([@eneskantepe](https://x.com/eneskantepe/status/2115093109860401463))** released **herdr-rooms**, an open-source plugin for herdr that sets up a *review room*: one coding agent writes, a second reviews read-only, and they iterate until they agree. Either Claude Code or Codex can fill either role.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - enes/herdr-rooms: Review rooms for herdr: a second coding agent reviews your session, read-only, until the two agree.

relevance: A drop-in writer/reviewer loop — the same independent-critic pattern the verification research recommends — packaged as a harness plugin.
